{{Top|leg}}
The '''MD-FA directional shield''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] system produced by [[Prexton]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Considered the most versatile shield available on the open market, it possessed moderate total stopping power and allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to shift shield strength and regeneration rate between the fore and aft shield arcs.
